Determining the "greatest" invention is subjective and can vary based on different criteria such as impact on human life, technological advancement, or cultural significance. However, many would argue that the invention of the wheel is one of the most significant. It revolutionized transportation and engineering, enabling the development of complex machinery and vehicles.

Others might argue for the invention of electricity, which has fundamentally transformed every aspect of modern life, from communication to healthcare and beyond. The internet, a more recent invention, has also been transformative, connecting people across the globe and enabling the rapid exchange of information.

Each invention has its own unique impact and importance, making it challenging to definitively label one as the "greatest."
